pages: They rang the bell. We did not expect the bell. The Master says a bell is a sound, and a sound cannot hurt the dead, and he is right, it did not hurt them - it held them. They stood in the rows and did not come up. The diggers had done something to the ground; he does not know what. He has taken one of their shovels into his rooms. He is sitting with it. He has not written anything.
